blockingIssues.description: Dashboard handler registers '/dashboard' but not '/dashboard/', causing GET /dashboard/ to miss SPA index fallback and return 404.
Mobile inspector drawer is unreachable on narrow screens because no control opens `showMobileInspector` while desktop-only expand control is gated behind `!isMobile`.
Keyboard shortcut `g then c` is not implemented correctly; current parser matches `g` alone, causing unintended navigation and not satisfying required key sequence behavior.

appliedUpdates.description: Updated `.factory/library/architecture.md` dashboard embedding section to reflect current explicit embed directive (`//go:embed ui/dist ui/index.html ui/app.js ui/styles.css ui/help ui/src`) instead of stale `ui/*` pattern.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Align Playwright and manual-verification steps with mission-level guidance: allow scoped Playwright specs during partial migration milestones and treat non-interactive exec-mode runs as automation-first validation (manual checks optional or delegated).
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Observed across multiple reviewed features (react-shared-components, react-migrate-help, react-migrate-docs, react-migrate-secrets, react-migrate-skills) where mission AGENTS guidance contradicted frontend-worker full-suite/manual requirements.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify baseline-validation exception handling when a feature explicitly exists to fix pre-existing baseline failures, so workers can proceed without marking procedural ambiguity.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Reported in react-playwright-runtime-bootstrap and fix-dashboard-embed-test-results-conflict handoffs as procedural deviation despite in-scope baseline-fix work.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Require immutable commit SHAs in worker handoffs (disallow symbolic refs like HEAD) to keep scrutiny diffs reproducible and unambiguous.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: react-embed-integration handoff recorded `commitId: HEAD`, which made exact review baseline ambiguous after later commits.
